title: Product B: Dosage Administration
shortdesc: Instruction for administering Product B at a dose of 2 mg/kg IV.

sections.content:
Confirm patient's eligibility for Product B treatment.
Step 1: Calculate the total dose of Product B based on the patient's weight (2 mg/kg). (Example: For example, a 70 kg patient requires a total dose of 140 mg (70 kg × 2 mg/kg).)
Step 2: Flush IV line with 0.9% sodium chloride injection before administration. Result: Make sure that the IV line appears clear without cloudiness or precipitate.
Step 3: Administer Product B at a dose of 2 mg/kg IV over 10 minutes. Note: Monitor patient's vital signs and adjust dosage as necessary.
Step 4: Flush IV line with 0.9% sodium chloride injection after administration. Result: Make sure that the IV line appears clear without cloudiness or precipitate.
